scientific_question: Conditional on a predeclared material stock-specific downside shock, does an exactly three-session post-shock recovery/stabilization sequence predict positive subsequent return beyond shock severity, a matched non-shock recovery path, pre-shock trend, volatility, liquidity, Low-MAX, and Strategy A?
distinctness: This is not Downside Resilience V2 or a sign inversion. The causal sequence is shock at s, observe only s+1 through s+3, confirm after s+3 close, and evaluate only from a later legal open.

universe.source: exact causal daily feature panel frozen by ASHARE-MULTISCALE-DIFFUSION-DAILY-ALPHA-CYCLE-015
universe.eligibility: hard-valid, PIT-lineage-valid, corporate-action-valid, current tradable non-ST rows with 120 consecutive valid stock sessions, exact prior-20 amount history, prior-20 average amount at least CNY 50 million, and at least six same-date PIT-industry peers
universe.industry: historical PIT industry on each session; daily industry return is the existing leave-one-out equal-weight eligible-peer log-return representation
universe.price_coordinate: accepted CY-006/QD-010 causal corporate-action coordinate; simple returns are expm1 of causal log steps and recovery price differences use causal-coordinate closes
universe.history_continuity: shock day, previous day, and s+1:s+3 must be consecutive accepted market sessions for the security; unresolved lineage or action fails closed

shock.absolute: expm1(stock causal step log return at s) <= -0.05
shock.industry_relative: expm1(stock causal step log return at s) - expm1(PIT-industry leave-one-out mean log return at s) <= -0.03
shock.shock_loss: causal-coordinate close(s-1) minus causal-coordinate close(s), required strictly positive

event_overlap.rule: after accepting a qualifying shock at s, suppress any new shock for the same security at s+1, s+2, or s+3; s+4 may begin a new event

observation.window: exactly three completed valid consecutive sessions s+1, s+2, s+3
observation.signal_known_at: after completed close s+3; decision_at 15:30 Asia/Shanghai
observation.earliest_entry: first accepted legal open strictly after s+3
observation.further_drawdown_ratio_3: max(0, causal-coordinate close(s)-min(close(s+1),close(s+2),close(s+3)))/shock_loss; lower is stronger stabilization
observation.industry_rel_recovery_3: sum over s+1:s+3 of stock causal step log return minus same-session PIT-industry leave-one-out mean log return; diagnostic only

ranking.assignment: within signal-confirmation date s+3 using deterministic average percentile rank and ceil(5*pct_rank), clipped to Q1..Q5
ranking.small_date_handling: retain in event-count audit but exclude dates unable to populate a five-bucket cross-sectional comparison

outcomes.entry: first accepted buyable legal open strictly after s+3, scanning no more than 20 market sessions
outcomes.absolute: accepted causal-coordinate return from legal entry open through each entry-relative close, net of 20 bps per side
outcomes.industry_relative: stock net outcome minus same confirmation-date initial-PIT-industry mean net outcome among complete ranked shock and matched non-shock observations
outcomes.broad_relative: stock net outcome minus same confirmation-date mean net outcome among complete ranked shock and matched non-shock observations
outcomes.mae: minimum accepted causal-coordinate low from entry through h20 relative to entry cost

shock_severity_control.test: within each fixed 3x3 shock-severity cell, compare recovery Q5 with Q1 at h5 and h20; report support rather than interpreting empty/tiny cells

generic_nonshock_control.domain: eligible negative-return stock-date that fails the joint shock definition, on the same shock date and preferably the same PIT industry as an accepted shock, with complete consecutive s+1:s+3 observation path
generic_nonshock_control.matching: one deterministic control per valid shock event: same shock date and PIT industry first, closest causal stock return to the shock event, then symbol; if no same-industry control exists, use same-date closest return; outcome is never used
generic_nonshock_control.representation: the same recovery and further-drawdown formulas, with its own positive one-day loss denominator
generic_nonshock_control.comparison: event versus matched non-shock Q5-Q1 recovery ordering at h5 and h20; no separate strategy or parameter search

coarse_controls.method: after raw shock-event results, assign fixed within-confirmation-date terciles and report recovery Q5-Q1 industry-relative outcomes inside each tercile
coarse_controls.pre_shock_trend: sum of causal stock step log returns over the 20 completed sessions ending s-1
coarse_controls.pre_shock_realized_volatility: sample standard deviation of causal stock step log returns over the same prior-20 sessions ending s-1
coarse_controls.liquidity: authoritative prior-20 average traded amount at shock day
coarse_controls.low_max_independence: exact max_return20 observed at signal confirmation s+3; diagnostic only

strategy_a_independence.champion: overlap with exact arm2_low_max selection at signal date and shock-event economics after removing those observations
strategy_a_independence.low_max: same-date rank correlation between Recovery Fraction and exact max_return20 plus fixed Low-MAX terciles

actionability.immediate: first market session after s+3 has accepted buyable open
actionability.delayed: a later accepted buyable open exists within 20 sessions

promising_requires: Q5 beats Q1 on absolute and industry-relative economics across multiple horizons
materially stronger or different than matched non-shock recovery
survives pre-trend, volatility, and liquidity controls

operational_gates_frozen_before_outcomes.multiple_horizons: positive Q5-Q1 at no fewer than 3 of h1/h3/h5/h10/h20
operational_gates_frozen_before_outcomes.chronology: positive industry-relative Q5-Q1 at h5 and h20 in both 2018-2021 and 2022-2023
operational_gates_frozen_before_outcomes.annual_support: positive industry-relative h20 Q5-Q1 in at least 4 of 6 calendar years
operational_gates_frozen_before_outcomes.stabilization: positive industry-relative Q5-Q1 at h5 and h20
operational_gates_frozen_before_outcomes.severity_support: a severity cell is supported with at least 20 Q1 and 20 Q5 outcomes; at least half of supported cells must have positive h20 industry-relative Q5-Q1
operational_gates_frozen_before_outcomes.generic_path_materiality: classify as generic when matched non-shock recovery has positive industry-relative Q5-Q1 and at least 75% of the shock-event spread at both h5 and h20
operational_gates_frozen_before_outcomes.coarse_controls: all three h20 terciles must have positive industry-relative recovery Q5-Q1 for each of pre-shock trend, pre-shock volatility, and liquidity
operational_gates_frozen_before_outcomes.actionability: at least 90% of ranked shock events reach an accepted legal open within 20 sessions
operational_gates_frozen_before_outcomes.low_max_independence: absolute mean same-date Spearman rank correlation below 0.70
operational_gates_frozen_before_outcomes.strategy_a_independence: industry-relative recovery Q5-Q1 remains positive at h5 and h20 after removing exact Champion selections
operational_gates_frozen_before_outcomes.chronologically_unstable: raw multi-horizon evidence is positive but early and late industry-relative Q5-Q1 signs reverse at h5 or h20
operational_gates_frozen_before_outcomes.defensive_only: h20 industry-relative Q5-Q1 is nonpositive while severe-loss incidence falls and MAE improves

prohibited: post-2023 outcome rows or indirect use
Downside Resilience lookback, direction, filter, threshold, or sign-inversion rescue
shock -4%, -6%, -7%, relative -2%/-4%, percentile, volatility-adjusted, or other threshold search

one-day, two-day, five-day, ten-day, intraday, candlestick, RSI, moving-average, support, reclaim, VWAP, volume-composite, gap, limit-down, sector, market-cap, Q1-inversion, or machine-learning rescue
